cutscenes.title: Seamless Cutscene to Gameplay
cutscenes.summary: A scripted cinematic that hands the player straight into live gameplay without a cut or a loading screen.
description: Built for a horror title, where breaking immersion breaks the fear. The cinematic runs on an authored timeline and, on its final beat, the camera is blended back onto the player rig so control is returned exactly where the shot ends, with no fade, no cut and no load.

The timeline breakdown shows how the shot is orchestrated: camera tracks, character animation, lighting and audio cues are sequenced against gameplay state, so the hand-off lands on the same frame every time.

videos.caption: Authoring view: camera, animation and gameplay cues sequenced on the timeline.

shaders.title: Paper / Sticker Fold Shader
shaders.summary: A customizable shader that simulates a paper or sticker fold along a configurable line.
description: A customizable shader designed to simulate paper or sticker folds. It uses two textures that are masked based on a configurable line defined by an angle and offset. One side retains the original texture, while the other side is replaced with a flat color to create the visual separation of the fold.
techniques: Two textures masked against a fold line defined by angle and offset
One side keeps the original texture, the other is replaced with a flat color
Fully configurable, so the fold can be animated or art-directed per asset

videos.label: Shader Showcase
videos.caption: Fold line driven by angle and offset, separating textured and flat-color sides.

shaders.title: Realtime Graphic Content Censorship
shaders.summary: Censors blood and gore in realtime, so one build can ship to stricter content ratings.
description: A custom shader designed to censor graphic content such as blood and gore. It samples the scene color, pixelates the UV coordinates, and reduces color saturation to create a stylized censorship effect.
techniques: Samples scene color as the shader input
Pixelates the UV coordinates for a stylized mosaic
Reduces color saturation to pull back the graphic content

videos.label: Censorship Enabled
videos.caption: Scene color pixelated and desaturated in realtime.

videos.label: Censorship Disabled
videos.caption: The same scene with the effect switched off, for comparison.

shaders.title: UV Light Shader
shaders.summary: Uses a Spot Light as a lighting mask, so blood decals only reveal where the light falls.
description: A custom shader that uses a Spot Light as a lighting mask. The assigned Spot Light is passed as a global shader value, allowing the shader to determine which areas of the blood decal are affected by the light and create a dynamic illuminated effect.
techniques: Spot Light passed to the shader as a global value
Light transform used as a mask to decide which decal areas are lit
Fully dynamic, the reveal follows the light as it moves

videos.label: UV Light Enabled
videos.caption: Blood decal revealed only inside the Spot Light mask.

videos.label: UV Light Disabled
videos.caption: The same scene without the light mask driving the decal.
